candidates.title: Newly delivered trams run clearance and EMC tests before entering service
candidates.search_snippet: Two of the newly delivered trams ran tests on the existing network this week.
candidates.source_content: Two of the trams recently delivered to the operator ran tests on the existing tram network this week before they enter passenger service. One tram was fitted with gauges and ran along two operating routes to confirm the clearance between the vehicle and the platforms. The other carried cables and sensors to measure the electromagnetic field produced by its on-board equipment and pantograph; the results will be evaluated later.
